messages:
Ellen: starting fractional rollout v2026.03.24-rc1 -> 15% global, regions=[na-east, eu-west]. Change window 04:00-05:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.03.24-rc1
DeployBot: deploy started id=fr-176444 target=15% regions=[na-east,eu-west]
Ravi: na-east 95p latency rising from 110ms -> 250ms at 4m. No 5xx yet.
Tom: eu-west looks fine. Is sticky session pinning on for this rollout?
QA-Lead: sticky sessions off by default for rc1. Shouldn't affect tail, but flagging.
SRE-Oncall: pulling traces for na-east. Suspect adapter cold-start + kv cache misses.
Ellen: pause na-east only, keep eu-west. Command: ``/deploy pause fr-176444 --region na-east``
DeployBot: acknowledged: paused fr-176444 for na-east. status: na-east=0%, eu-west=15% -> global~7.5%
Ravi: confirming traffic shift. na-east pinned to v2026.03.23-stable.
SRE-Oncall: recommend quick warmup + enable sticky session pin for na-east to avoid cold rebinds, and set PREFETCH=1 temporarily.
Tom: sticky pin might affect balancing. Is it lightweight?
SRE-Oncall: small risk but reduces repeated cold-starts for same clients; ok for limited region.
Ellen: QA-Lead, can you run warmup and toggle sticky?
QA-Lead: running: ``infra/warmup --region na-east --model rc1 && infra/toggle-sticky --region na-east on``
DeployBot: warmup job started job=warmup-176444-ne
QA-Lead: warmup done. PREFETCH set to 1, sticky sessions enabled. kv-hit improved 0.41 -> 0.89.
Ravi: propose ramp 2% -> 7% -> 15% with 4m intervals. Safer to observe tails.
Ellen: agree. ``/deploy resume fr-176444 --region na-east --ramp 2,7,15 --interval 4m``
DeployBot: resuming fr-176444: na-east ramp=2%->7%->15% intervals=4m; eu-west remains 15%
SRE-Oncall: added temporary alert for sticky-session-error and kv-miss-rate. Monitoring.
Tom: na-east at 2% 95p back to 120ms.
Ravi: at 7% stable.
Ellen: at 15% na-east. Leaving region pin for 1h. If regressions happen: use ``/deploy rollback fr-176444`` or ``/deploy pause fr-176444 --region <region>``
DeployBot: rollout complete fr-176444 -> 15% active. Rollback command available.
QA-Lead: updating changelog: "rc1: temporary sticky-sessions + PREFETCH warmup to mitigate adapter cold-starts in na-east."
SRE-Oncall: LGTM. Will escalate on threshold breach. :white_check_mark:
